synthesis.move: Synthesize the Directory-Picker Mode Divergence and Order Law into a Round 80 Capability Expansion (`chromium-showpicker-directory-linux`) with Static Case-Count Reconciliation in the Battery.
evidence: R79Probe probe.json: probe-dis-nogesture throws InvalidStateError ('HTMLInputElement::showPicker() cannot be used on immutable controls.') even with 0 user activation, proving that Blink evaluates control mutability before checking user gesture.

R79Exec3 probe.json: probe-q1-webkitdirectory on <input type=file webkitdirectory> fires Page.fileChooserOpened with mode: 'selectSingle', proving that showPicker() diverges from pointer clicks which fire selectFolder.
claims.json:14 vs scored c1-negatives-a.json: claims text specifies 87 cases, whereas the committed frozen battery ran 90 cases (90 passed, 0 failed, 56 covered).
risks: Web automation clients expecting showPicker() to open directory pickers on webkitdirectory inputs receive single-file pickers instead.
Claims case-count drift re-emerges if battery cases are modified without automated claims synchronizer in pre-freeze checks.
verification: Execute probe-q1-webkitdirectory: verify Page.fileChooserOpened mode is selectSingle.
Execute probe-dis-nogesture: verify InvalidStateError thrown with isActive: false.
Assert c1-negatives-a.json cases equals 90 and allOk: true.
